brief:
Settlers are continuing construction work to expand an outpost located north of Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The expansion activity has proceeded at the settlement site without apparent interruption, adding to the physical footprint of the unauthorized settlement.

The work represents an ongoing pattern of settlement expansion in areas surrounding the Palestinian capital. Israeli settlements and outposts in the West Bank, including those near Jerusalem, remain a central point of contention in Israeli-Palestinian disputes over land and territorial control. The specific scale and timeline of the current expansion effort were not detailed in available reporting.
title: Settlers expand outpost north of Jerusalem
